about: Areas published as offline map packs by the 'Deploy website and offline maps' workflow. bbox = [west, south, east, north] in degrees (longitude, latitude). maxzoom 15 is street detail; the app keeps zooming in using the same data. GitHub Pages allows 1 GB per site: packs are added in this order and any pack that would pass about 950 MB in total is left out (the workflow log says so). Edit this list and commit; the next run cuts the new packs.
